clips.title: The story
paras: Stonewatch Keep remains under Gath'Ilzogg's command in the Redridge Mountains. The Blackrock warlord's force holds the fortress and raids Lakeshire, where Magistrate Solomon has placed a bounty on him.

Gath'Ilzogg came north from the Burning Steppes to secure Redridge for the Blackrock clan. With help from the renegade human warlock Morganth's foul sorcery, his warband battered Stonewatch Keep's defenders and seized the heights above the region. From the fortress, Gath'Ilzogg directs raids through the valleys and toward Lakeshire's bridge, tightening pressure on the human settlement. Elite Blackrock guards and a vicious black dragon whelp named Singe stay close to him.
